transcript: We built this AI agent for Comet, the hottest sneaker brand in India right now, and this one fixes a problem most D2C brands don't even know is bleeding them customers. Picture this: Comet drops its brand new shoe segment and somebody comments, "It's a scam just to make hype," "Site is hanged purposely," "What's the use," or puts out a complaint in the comment section hoping for a reply they might never get. Now, ignoring these comments was the old way. The new way is the AI agents way. Four AI agents fire instantly. The listener agent catches it the second it's posted, tagged or not, across every single platform Comet shows up on. The judge agent reads who is saying it so that the same complaint hits differently coming from a real audience account versus a random troll account. The Sentinel agent isn't watching one comment, it's watching the pattern. When similar complaints start repeating fast, that's flagged as a crisis before it ever gets the chance to become a social media trend. And the ghostwriter agent replies to them in Comet's own voice in minutes, while quietly moving the real issue off the comment section to get resolved. This fabulous AI system is just a small part of a bigger multi-agent framework that we run for D2C brands all across the globe at LanceMart AI, which is an AI consultancy and automation company. Now if you want the roadmap to build this particular AI system for yourself or your brand, or for a brand that you work with, just comment "AI" and I'll send it across to your DMs right away. And also tag Comet so they can actually fix what's wrong. Ciao, I'll see you in the next one.
